e.title: Awesome Risk Quantification（榜单）
e.summary: 风险量化资源大榜单（472★）：项目/博客/书/演讲——保险精算与金融风险量化方法论导航
e.body:
awesome-risk-quantification（veeral-patel，472★）是风险量化（risk quantification）主题的精选资源榜：汇集量化风险领域的项目、博客、书籍与演讲——覆盖从精算/保险风险到金融风险量化的方法论。对 RIAA：风险量化学习路线图式导航（与 [[awesome-actuarial]]、[[awesome-sustainable-finance]] 同族榜单）——按主题找到对应工具与经典资料；作为精算风险侧（准备金/定价/资本）与金融风险（市场/信用/操作）的交叉索引。

e.body_en:
awesome-risk-quantification (veeral-patel, 472★) is a curated list of resources on risk quantification: projects, blog posts, books and talks covering quantification methodology from actuarial/insurance risk to financial risk. For RIAA: a roadmap-style navigation for risk quantification (sibling of [[awesome-actuarial]] and [[awesome-sustainable-finance]]) — find the tools and classic material per topic; a cross-index of the actuarial risk side (reserving/pricing/capital) with financial risk (market/credit/operational).
